view: top-down (bird's-eye) camera looking straight down at a plain light-grey floor; one dark-grey sports car seen from above, nose pointing LEFT (-x), driving left along image row y~718

camera.evidence: phase correlation of car-free bands (y 50-400, 1000-1400) vs frame 0: shift <= 0.08 px, mean |diff| <= 0.08 grey levels in all frames
camera.perspective_cues: none usable: featureless floor with a radial lighting vignette (darker toward the corners). Apparent car length shrinks slightly as it moves right->left (see objects.car.size_px), probably mild perspective of body parts at different heights; treat as 2D with one px scale.

car.description: dark-grey/black sports car (top view), light-grey windscreen/cockpit glass, white rear plate area; the only object in the scene
car.visible_frames: 0-71 (fully inside frame 0-60; front leaves the left edge at frame 61; frames 61-71 truncated by left image edge, rear end still visible at frame 71 with rear bumper at x~118)
car.reference_point: ref_x, ref_y in car.csv = car centre (approx. vehicle root in top view). ref_x = 1596.5 + rigid template shift of the rear end (sub-pixel, valid in all 72 frames incl. truncated ones); ref_y = 718.0 constant (no vertical motion, template dy = 0 every frame)
car.motion: rest at frames 0-1 (identical positions), then moves monotonically in -x (leftward) with steadily increasing per-frame steps: ~1.3 px (1->2), ~10 px (11->12), ~26.6 px (29->30), ~45 px (47->48), ~63.4 px (70->71). No turning (body axis angle within +-0.5 deg), no vertical motion.

size_px.length_along_motion_x: body mask (car without shadow): 788 px at frames 0-9 (car at rest/slow, right side of image), 776 at f30, 767 at f40 (centred near image centre x=1280), 742-744 at f58-60. Recommended single value: 776 +- 15 px (median of frames 0-60 is ~776). Including the faint grey fringe in front of the nose (likely shadow) adds ~15 px.
size_px.width_across_y: 366 px (body mask y 536-901), constant in every frame
size_px.full_mask_with_shadow: y 498-903 (406 px); shadow is the mid-grey band ~38 px above the car's top (image-top) side and ~15 px ahead of the nose

car.occlusion: none; truncated by left image edge from frame 61

car_shadow.description: mid-grey cast shadow offset toward image top (and slightly left) of the car; moves with car; not part of the car's size

floor.description: plain light-grey ground plane filling the whole image, no markings, lines or texture; radial brightness vignette (centre ~220 grey, corners ~170-200)
